_readme: HELD-OUT evaluation set. Authored BEFORE the interpreter prompt/validator existed. Never used to tune prompts, lexicons or code. Do not add these sentences to any parser, prompt or dev fixture. Outcomes: call (a daemon tool is invoked), clarify (a question/refusal, NO daemon action), none (not a workflow-management request: falls through to the normal runtime, NO daemon action). 'accept' lists every safe-and-correct outcome. For calls, 'args' is a subset the final daemon arguments must match.
